newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic up on technical trading factors.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic up on technical trading factors.

text.p: Shares in medical devices maker Medtronic Inc rose 5-3/8 to 86-1/4 early Tuesday on what the company said seemed to be technical trading factors.
"There are no developments here at all," said Medtronic spokesman Dick Reid.
The stock closed down sharply Monday on a selling imbalance after specialists stepped in, while Tuesday's jump appeared to be a technical rebound, Reid said.
An index fund sold a large block of about 200,000 Medtronic shares at a sharp discount to the market price near Monday's closing bell, analysts said.

"It seemed like logic just didn't apply. It was just dumped," said Vector Securities medical technology analyst David Gruber. "It was just an anomalous sort of event. I wouldn't pay much attention to it."
